effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name, this Digimon may digivolve into [Diaboromon] in your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name is played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
